name: PT FKS Food Sejahtera Tbk
summary: PT FKS Food Sejahtera Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the industrial and wholesale trade of various food products in Indonesia. The company offers staple food; snack Products, including instant noodles, instant vermicelli, extruded snacks, candies, and others, as well as wafer stick and biscuit. It is also involved in manufacture, transportation, warehousing, wholesale, and retail trade of macaroni, bread and cake products, snacks, soybean food, and confectionery products, as well as agricultures businesses.
